_comment: Epic workspace durable paths. Playbooks use {EpicDir} = epics/<KEY>/. Resolver: automation/tools/epic_paths.py

pre_close.note: Only coverage.md at epic root during active pipeline. All JSON and non-coverage md live under dependencies/.

post_close.note: CLOSE promotes analysis.md and tests.md from dependencies/ to epic root; JSON moves to context/.

_legacy_root_json_fallback: Verifiers accept pre-migration JSON at epic root when dependencies/ copy missing (read-only fallback).
